segments.text: Gumgumi drops popcorn kernels into a pot on the stove.
They look dry and hard, but suddenly pop with a bang.
There's tiny moisture trapped inside the starch.
Heat turns that water into steam.
The steam tries to expand, building up pressure.
The hull holds on until it can't take any more, then bursts.
The moment it bursts, the starch puffs right up.
That's why popcorn puffs up white when it pops.
